findings.summary: In the drifted-repair branch (alt-only first pass, repair adds a violation elsewhere) the pipeline uses the generic buildFallbackHeadlineEn even when the repair returned a valid alternative (e.g. 'Mexican Peso Slips After Strong U.S. Jobs Data' in the new test), losing the driver-specific option.
findings.action: Before falling back, try validate(current.report, next.headlineAlternative, sourceNumbers); use the repaired alternative with the first-pass report when clean, otherwise the deterministic fallback.
